statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative-template audit. Video playback, logged-in account management, checkout/premium payment, creator upload, and live-chat journeys were not covered because they require external services, credentials, payment, or content playback; one representative public listing per template was used.

page.notes: Public adult-media discovery site with a first-load consent interstitial, age-verification banner, responsive variants, multilingual subdomains, and account signup.

checkOutcomes.method: Compare default and prefers-color-scheme: light screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The light-scheme capture remains the same dark surface as the default page; no user-scheme retint is visible.
Eight 2-second shimmer animations remain running while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility contrast audit and high-contrast screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 contrast failures, including the age banner at 2.15:1 and metadata at 3.29:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspect loaded stylesheets for view-transition usage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS inspection found zero view-transition rules on route-heavy MPA surfaces.
Trace showed no scroll animation workload and CSS/DOM inspection found no scroll-timeline implementation or main-thread scroll effect requiring replacement.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM and screenshot recon across representative paths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No gesture-driven carousel, swipe-to-remove, pull-to-refresh, or comparable physical interaction is present on the representative surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browse, taxonomy, search, signup, and error surfaces do not expose a gesture-specific interaction.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The persistent top navigation and sidebar preserve location and major destinations throughout the long listing.
No edge-sensitive tooltip, menu, or anchored overlay was exposed in the representative core paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay use case was present in the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: H1/H2 hierarchy, selected navigation state, and prominent search field provide visible next-step cues.

checkOutcomes.method: First-load screenshots on homepage and signup.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A large cookie interstitial blocks the primary content and account form on first load; the age banner adds a second interruption on mobile.
The consent overlay is not represented by native <dialog>, [popover], or role=dialog; probes found zero semantic dialog/popover primitives.
On desktop the sidebar, two-level header, age-verification banner, and consent overlay leave little primary content visible; signup is almost completely obscured.
At a 360px visual viewport, layout reported scrollWidth 1024px and 664px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows clipped desktop chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse mobile rendering and viewport DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse mobile rendered a dedicated two-column mobile listing and the DOM viewport meta is width=device-width; components do adapt under a mobile user-agent.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus style probe and Lighthouse target-size audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused search controls expose no outline or box shadow, and Lighthouse found two insufficient target-size/spacing cases.

checkOutcomes.method: First viewport screenshot and heading/link probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The title, Trending Free Porn Videos H1, search field, categories, and listing cards clearly communicate the discovery purpose and next actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Manual route traversal with screenshots and DOM snapshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Browse via homepage, category index, category listing, search-query surface, and signup email reveal all loaded without an auth wall; content cards and navigation remained available.
A missing URL produced a dedicated Page not found surface rather than a blank shell, while search and signup exposed recognisable states.
Lighthouse lab LCP was 3810ms (performance 0.86), above the 2.5s good threshold; CLS was 0 and TBT was 0 in that run.
Both layout and Lighthouse measured CLS 0 with no observed layout-shift entries.
The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 161.93ms, with 126.24ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary corroborated by DOM resource inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load issued 146 requests and transferred 1.70MB; 10 parser-inserted render-blocking candidates were identified and the largest script was 400KB.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse unused-code audits and HAR summary.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26,976 bytes unused JavaScript and 57,478 bytes unused CSS; HAR counted 63 scripts.
Lighthouse found an unnamed button, and the image audit found one image without alt text.
Lighthouse found 13 low-contrast nodes, including 1.75:1 secondary age-banner text and 3.29:1 view-count text.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus probe and Lighthouse structural audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search input/button focus has no visible outline; Lighthouse also found a malformed list and nine visible-label/accessibility-name mismatches.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse node-level contrast evidence and screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Repeated 12px metadata uses #707070 on #202020 at 3.29:1, and banner text falls as low as 1.75:1, impairing reading comfort.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport/target audits plus narrow layout.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports a restrictive mobile viewport and two target-size failures; independent 360px layout evidence shows 664px overflow.
Lighthouse recorded no browser console errors.
The document has doctype and charset, but 29 of 36 images lack explicit width/height dimensions.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0 with no console, deprecation, prompt-on-load, or inspector hygiene failure reported.
Raw and rendered HTML both retain a descriptive title, one H1, and meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability, Lighthouse SEO, and narrow layout.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links and raw content are crawlable, but the 360px layout overflows by 664px, so the combined mobile-friendly outcome fails.

checkOutcomes.method: robots.txt, sitemap route, DOM, and Lighthouse SEO inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: robots.txt is valid and canonical/hreflang pass Lighthouse, but /sitemap.xml returns a 404 page, leaving no sitemap at the conventional location.
The home DOM has no JSON-LD, Open Graph title/description/image, or Twitter card metadata.
HTTPS/HSTS and frame protection are present, but CSP is limited to frame-ancestors, HSTS max-age is only 86400, and nosniff and Referrer-Policy headers are missing.
117 of 146 requests and 1.59MB of 1.70MB transferred bytes went to third-party origins, including Google Accounts and tsyndicate; 11 third-party origins were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup DOM/form inspection and script/API probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the inspected signup flow exposes password/social auth and no passkey/WebAuthn affordance.
Three of four cookies lack Secure and two use SameSite=None; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are absent and CSP does not constrain script sources.
Raw HTML is 390,743 bytes, not a JS shell, and preserves 89% of rendered content words plus title/H1/description.

checkOutcomes.method: Route traversal, overlay probe, and Lighthouse console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative routes and the consent/signup state rendered without runtime console errors; no unstable edge-positioned overlay was exposed.
The primary product is network-streamed media; offline task completion is not a meaningful expectation for the audited public browsing journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: Streaming and live discovery require network access; offline/installable behaviour is contextual and not part of the observed core task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberately missing route rendered a dedicated Page not found experience with the normal site shell rather than crashing or presenting an empty document.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM comparison of normal and error routes plus logical-property probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Main pages declare lang=en and CSS inspection found 19 logical-property rules, but the Page not found document has no html lang value.
The navigation exposes many locale-specific domains and valid hreflang signals; locale selection is explicit and server-rendered.

checkOutcomes.method: Content and DOM recon across representative paths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No date, event, schedule, recurrence, or time-zone-sensitive data appears in the representative public browse/signup/error surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive feature was present in scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Cookie Accept and Reject controls have equal size/prominence, and signup explicitly discloses public-data use, terms, and privacy policy.

checkOutcomes.method: Active signup form reveal and empty-submit probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Revealed signup inputs are not marked required and expose no aria-invalid state; an empty submission attempt navigated the inspected target before an inline recoverable error could be observed.
Both email fields declare autocomplete=off; only the password field uses autocomplete=new-password.
The signup surface clearly states age-verification implications, public-data handling, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy before account creation.
14 of 36 images are oversized, 29 lack dimensions, 14 use legacy formats, and 8 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: Reduced-motion animation probe, trace, and HAR.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page starts eight continuously running shimmer animations even under reduced motion and loads 63 scripts on the initial listing.
Third parties account for 117 requests and 1.59MB transferred; the initial page totals 146 requests before a user starts media playback.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source API recon and site-intent judgement.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent-facing or local-AI task is declared or apparent for the public media discovery pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site exposes ordinary human browsing/forms and no agentic or on-device inference use case; this contextual principle is out of scope.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source API recon and site-intent judgement.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent-facing or local-AI task is declared or apparent for the public media discovery pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site exposes ordinary human browsing/forms and no agentic or on-device inference use case; this contextual principle is out of scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten full-page scroll cycles, heap self-size rose 2.26% (36.45MB to 37.27MB) and nodes 2.40% (682,892 to 699,268), consistent with bounded lazy content rather than clear unbounded retention.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap-summary totals compared with page purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap self-size was 36.45MB for a media-rich page; the post-scroll state remained 37.27MB without disproportionate growth.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor summaries and interaction comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appeared in either top-constructor summary, and repeated scrolling produced only modest bounded growth; no listener/timer accumulation signal was observed.

paths.description: Homepage and primary video-discovery listing; represents global navigation, consent, recommendations, and first-load behaviour.
Category index; represents taxonomy and listing navigation.
British category page; represents a category-specific result listing.
Search-query surface; represents the primary find-content journey.
Signup page and email form reveal; represents account creation, consent disclosure, and form assistance.
Deliberate missing route; represents HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: Light preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The light-scheme capture remains the same dark surface as the default page; no user-scheme retint is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme support and theme tokens that respond to prefers-color-scheme; retain a manual override.

findings.summary: Loading shimmer ignores reduced motion
findings.evidence: Eight 2-second shimmer animations remain running while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or replace repeating shimmer animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Contrast preference and baseline contrast are insufficient
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 contrast failures, including the age banner at 2.15:1 and metadata at 3.29:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase text/control contrast and add tested prefers-contrast/forced-colors treatment.

findings.summary: Route changes do not preserve visual continuity
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found zero view-transition rules on route-heavy MPA surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for compatible route/list-detail changes with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: First-load interstitial obscures core content
findings.evidence: A large cookie interstitial blocks the primary content and account form on first load; the age banner adds a second interruption on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise the consent surface, preserve necessary legal choice, and avoid stacking it with the age banner.

findings.summary: Consent overlay lacks dialog semantics
findings.evidence: The consent overlay is not represented by native <dialog>, [popover], or role=dialog; probes found zero semantic dialog/popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the modal with <dialog>, an accessible name, focus management, Escape handling, and explicit non-coercive actions.

findings.summary: Navigation and overlays crowd out content
findings.evidence: On desktop the sidebar, two-level header, age-verification banner, and consent overlay leave little primary content visible; signup is almost completely obscured.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary navigation at constrained heights and avoid simultaneous banners/overlays.

findings.summary: Narrow viewport overflows by 664px
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, layout reported scrollWidth 1024px and 664px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows clipped desktop chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Make layout sizing fluid, remove 1024px minimum assumptions, and test 320–412px viewports without relying on user-agent switching.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are inadequate
findings.evidence: Focused search controls expose no outline or box shadow, and Lighthouse found two insufficient target-size/spacing cases.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible :focus-visible rings and at least 24px targets with spacing, preferably 44px for primary controls.

findings.summary: Lab LCP is 3.81 seconds
findings.evidence: Lighthouse lab LCP was 3810ms (performance 0.86), above the 2.5s good threshold; CLS was 0 and TBT was 0 in that run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce initial script/style work, and measure field LCP/INP/CLS.

findings.summary: Long tasks block the main thread
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 161.93ms, with 126.24ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Split the 162ms task, defer non-critical work, and schedule background work at lower priority.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is request-heavy and script-heavy
findings.evidence: The load issued 146 requests and transferred 1.70MB; 10 parser-inserted render-blocking candidates were identified and the largest script was 400KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce parser-critical resources, bundle/request overhead, and the 400KB index script; retain only truly critical preloads.

findings.summary: Unused CSS/JS ships on first load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26,976 bytes unused JavaScript and 57,478 bytes unused CSS; HAR counted 63 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split features and remove unused initial CSS/JS identified by coverage.

findings.summary: Some controls and images lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed button, and the image audit found one image without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every interactive control a programmatic name and every meaningful image appropriate alt text.

findings.summary: Text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 low-contrast nodes, including 1.75:1 secondary age-banner text and 3.29:1 view-count text.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise banner, metadata, and button contrast to at least WCAG AA ratios across states.

findings.summary: Focus and list semantics are broken
findings.evidence: Search input/button focus has no visible outline; Lighthouse also found a malformed list and nine visible-label/accessibility-name mismatches.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore visible keyboard focus, valid list children, and accessible names that match visible labels.

findings.summary: Small low-contrast metadata is hard to read
findings.evidence: Repeated 12px metadata uses #707070 on #202020 at 3.29:1, and banner text falls as low as 1.75:1, impairing reading comfort.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase metadata size/contrast and maintain comfortable line-height and wrapping.

findings.summary: Zoom, reflow, and target sizing fail mobile accessibility
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a restrictive mobile viewport and two target-size failures; independent 360px layout evidence shows 664px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom, remove horizontal overflow, and increase/space small targets.

findings.summary: Most images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The document has doctype and charset, but 29 of 36 images lack explicit width/height dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio on thumbnails so layout can reserve space before image load.

findings.summary: Crawlable content is not reliably mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: Links and raw content are crawlable, but the 360px layout overflows by 664px, so the combined mobile-friendly outcome fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix narrow reflow/overflow while preserving server-rendered anchors and metadata.

findings.summary: Conventional sitemap URL returns 404
findings.evidence: robots.txt is valid and canonical/hreflang pass Lighthouse, but /sitemap.xml returns a 404 page, leaving no sitemap at the conventional location.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish and reference a sitemap index or document the alternate sitemap location in robots.txt.

findings.summary: Structured and social metadata are absent
findings.evidence: The home DOM has no JSON-LD, Open Graph title/description/image, or Twitter card metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add content-accurate JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata for key templates.

findings.summary: Security header policy is incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS and frame protection are present, but CSP is limited to frame-ancestors, HSTS max-age is only 86400, and nosniff and Referrer-Policy headers are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a script-restricting CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a long-lived HSTS policy after rollout validation.

findings.summary: Most initial traffic goes to third parties
findings.evidence: 117 of 146 requests and 1.59MB of 1.70MB transferred bytes went to third-party origins, including Google Accounts and tsyndicate; 11 third-party origins were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each third party, eliminate nonessential requests, gate optional integrations on consent, and proxy/self-host where appropriate.

findings.summary: Signup has no passkey path
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the inspected signup flow exposes password/social auth and no passkey/WebAuthn affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn alongside existing methods and introduce them only in the authentication context.

findings.summary: Cookies and browser policies are weak
findings.evidence: Three of four cookies lack Secure and two use SameSite=None; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are absent and CSP does not constrain script sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, avoid SameSite=None unless required, and strengthen CSP/referrer/nosniff policies.

findings.summary: The 404 document omits language metadata
findings.evidence: Main pages declare lang=en and CSS inspection found 19 logical-property rules, but the Page not found document has no html lang value.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang (and dir where needed) on every template, including errors.

findings.summary: Signup lacks semantic required/error states
findings.evidence: Revealed signup inputs are not marked required and expose no aria-invalid state; an empty submission attempt navigated the inspected target before an inline recoverable error could be observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark required inputs, validate after interaction, keep users in context, and announce errors with aria-live/aria-invalid.

findings.summary: Email autofill is disabled
findings.evidence: Both email fields declare autocomplete=off; only the password field uses autocomplete=new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email/username and preserve autocomplete=new-password; do not disable useful autofill.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and layout work
findings.evidence: 14 of 36 images are oversized, 29 lack dimensions, 14 use legacy formats, and 8 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve right-sized modern responsive images, lazy-load below-fold media, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Continuous shimmer and initial scripts waste work
findings.evidence: The page starts eight continuously running shimmer animations even under reduced motion and loads 63 scripts on the initial listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop nonessential animation under reduced motion/when hidden and defer background/non-visible work.

findings.summary: Third-party request budget is excessive
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 117 requests and 1.59MB transferred; the initial page totals 146 requests before a user starts media playback.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce request/byte budgets, especially for third-party scripts and pre-play media.

taskList.title: Fix narrow layout, reflow, zoom, and controls
Repair accessible names, contrast, semantics, and focus
Cut initial script/request and third-party cost
Improve metadata, sitemap, and error-template language
Make signup validation and autofill humane
